affinity.notes: Stone-integrated coat, mineral dorsal growth, fractured ground, and dust change material, silhouette, and environmental wake beyond color.

anatomy.notes: Only three paws are visible; the far hind leg is fully occluded, violating the exactly-four-legs and every-extremity-visible invariants.

archetype.notes: Raised shoulders and loaded forequarters clearly communicate close-range bruiser and overrun pressure.

counterplay.notes: The committed pose reads, but uniformly distributed stone seams provide no localized exposed fracture, binding joint, or load-bearing fault.

finish.notes: Canvas is polished and complete with one featured subject and no text, UI, watermark, or unfinished area.

framing.notes: The canvas does not crop the bear, but the hidden fourth extremity fails the declared full-body-readable contract.

identity.notes: Ursine face, heavy shoulder mass, and powerful forelimbs strongly preserve the Cave Bear identity.

tier.notes: Presentation remains bridge-only and makes no canonical family or T1-T5 tier claim.
